column1: # docs/_GOLDENS.tsv - the pixel baseline for the restructure lessons. EMPTY ON PURPOSE.
# Recorded at git tag end-of-44, once lessons 43 (streaming) and 44 (cloud octree) are typed:
# Recording it before then bakes in numbers from a tree that is only at end-of-42, and the seven
# byte-identical Move lessons would then be gated against the wrong frame.
# The baseline is a TAG, not a working tree. The live tree carries edits no lesson doc contains
# median loop, DEMO_SCENE_URL commented out), and `show_mesh_edges: false` alone gates two draws.
# Tag first, record second, and pin Cargo.lock - `wgpu = "29.0"` is a caret range and an
# unpinned resolver makes a golden diff indistinguishable from a regression.
# MANDATORY - lion, bunny, bunny_cloud, drawings_rotated. Every .pb they name is TRACKED, so a
# fresh clone reproduces these. x4 configs x2 passes = 32 rows.
# ADVISORY - drawings, bunny_drawings, cloud_mix, lidar14. Their .pb assets are gitignored
# (>50 MB); _gate.sh skips them loudly by name when absent and they never fail the gate.
# ppm_sha256_16 reads `nondet(splat)` for cloud scenes: the splat lane is a 2-pass atomic compute
# rasterizer, so contested pixels are a race. MEASURED 2026-08-31 - `lion` produced three distinct
# PPM hashes over eight runs while ink/draws/objects were 77543/4/1 every single time.
